name: Hot Coffee
source:
As an artist you seldom leave your house save for the occasional shopping and perhaps a can of coffee.

When you finally step outside, you find a peculiar person standing in front of a vending machine.

Approaching strangers for no reason is unthinkable! But if you did...

Maybe something good may come out of it?
